The main takeaway from our work is that

the elongation of unsaturated fatty acids in the brain is not limited to 18:1, 20:1, or 22:1, but also involves the elongation of docosenoate (22:1), tetracosenoyl-CoAs (24:1-CoAs), and hexacosenoyl CoAs (26:1-CoA).
